The Text Style transfer (TST) task is a form of controlled language generation.

The Text Style transfer (TST) task is a form of controlled language generation. The goal is to produce fluent style-altered sentences from a given base sentence, while also preserving its style-independent content.

Evaluation for text style transfer includes checking for a) Style Transfer accuracy, b) Content preservation metrics and c) Fluency of output sentences. ...
